reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a senior unsecured loan of up to EUR 3 million to Agrana Nile Fruits to finance the Company's investment plans for the construction, equipping and placing into operation of a new production line, as well as to refurbish the existing facility in Obour City, Egypt. The Project will increase annual production capacity of the Company, as well as enhance its operational efficiency. The Project will allow the Company to expand its export base and eventually become a net exporter of high-quality fruit ingredients to leading dairy produces in Middle East and West Africa.
